أتفاقم (form VI)
# أَتَفَاقَمُ (ʔatafāqamu) /ʔa.ta.faː.qa.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَفَاقَمَ (tafāqama)
# أَتَفَاقَمَ (ʔatafāqama) /ʔa.ta.faː.qa.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَفَاقَمَ (tafāqama)
# أَتَفَاقَمْ (ʔatafāqam) /ʔa.ta.faː.qam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَفَاقَمَ (tafāqama)
